affected_party: operators and governance reviewers deciding whether recovery evidence can support re-entry review
actual_problem: QIF v0.8.18 links recovery evidence but cannot show whether agent, runtime, monitor, replay harness, evidence collector, and reviewer share control, substrate, or failure modes
why_it_matters: Correlated or self-reported evidence can appear complete while every layer repeats the same blind spot or compromise
why_now: Current research and incident guidance emphasize independent monitoring, third-party evaluation, full-system incident roles, and graded principal, substrate, and evidence independence
